entities.name: Alberto Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Alberto Hernández Pérez  is a Cuban baseball player and Olympic gold medalist. He was born in Holguín, Cuba. Hernández is a two time Gold medalist for baseball, winning at the 1992 Summer Olympics and the 1996 Summer Olympics.
